# 1ms.dog

> Free browser tool: shows the visitor's exit IP (IPv4, IPv6, ISP/ASN, city, nearest Cloudflare edge, proxy/VPN/WebRTC
> hints) and times real HTTPS round trips from their browser to 40 major services plus a local pack
> chosen by exit country. Everything runs client-side; no results are sent to 1ms.dog.

- Home: https://1ms.dog/ (also /zh-cn/, /zh-tw/, /ja/, /ko/, /es/, /fr/, /de/, /pt/, /ru/)
- Service pages: https://1ms.dog/chatgpt/, https://1ms.dog/claude/, https://1ms.dog/gemini/, https://1ms.dog/google/, https://1ms.dog/youtube/, https://1ms.dog/netflix/, https://1ms.dog/tiktok/, https://1ms.dog/x/, https://1ms.dog/discord/, https://1ms.dog/telegram/, https://1ms.dog/github/, https://1ms.dog/steam/
- Group pages: https://1ms.dog/ai/, https://1ms.dog/web/, https://1ms.dog/video/, https://1ms.dog/social/, https://1ms.dog/dev/, https://1ms.dog/game/, https://1ms.dog/cdn/, https://1ms.dog/region/cn/, https://1ms.dog/region/tw/, https://1ms.dog/region/jp/, https://1ms.dog/region/kr/, https://1ms.dog/region/ru/, https://1ms.dog/region/in/, https://1ms.dog/region/sea/, https://1ms.dog/region/eu/, https://1ms.dog/region/latam/, https://1ms.dog/region/na/, https://1ms.dog/region/me/
- Service status from Tokyo (latency and uptime of every service, measured every 10 minutes by 1ms.dog's server in Tokyo): https://1ms.dog/status/ (data: https://1ms.dog/baseline.json)
- Services tested: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot, Grok, DeepSeek, Google, Apple, Microsoft, Wikipedia, Amazon, Zoom, YouTube, Netflix, TikTok, Twitch, Spotify, X, Instagram, Facebook, WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Reddit, GitHub, npm, Docker Hub, PyPI, Hugging Face, Steam, PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo, Epic Games, Cloudflare, Akamai, Amazon CloudFront, Google Cloud CDN, Fastly, Azure Front Door
- Speed grades (median HTTPS round trip): 1ms dog < 2 ms, Zoomies ≤ 30, Sprint ≤ 80, Trot ≤ 150, Stroll ≤ 300, Nap > 300, Not back = no connection in 5 s
